name: go-grpc-middleware-transactional-middleware-946e
instr:
Add request-scoped transactional compensation to unary and streaming RPC middleware. Callers can register named cleanup work that commits on success or rolls back at the applicable failure boundary. Compensation must remain coherent through policy decisions, retries, recovered panics, cancellation, context replacement, and optional reporting without affecting unconfigured calls.

Every managed client or server RPC shares one compensation identity through derived contexts and resolves exactly once: success commits, while terminal failure executes accepted callbacks once in reverse registration order. Streaming scopes remain active across successful messages, while validation failures and retry attempts use independent savepoints so local work rolls back without prematurely ending the call. Authentication, validation, rate limiting, and selector delegation preserve their existing results while rejections complete pending rollback before returning and bypasses neither replace nor resolve the scope. Recovery isolates callback errors and panics, records every result, finishes rollback, and only then exposes the recovered error; cancellation similarly preserves the first terminal cause. Concurrent registration and duplicate completion produce one immutable, deterministic snapshot, reject later registration with `ErrScopeClosed`, and never rerun callbacks.
